hotel reservations department, OR- group sales department, OR- front office with strong email handling responsibility- Strong understanding of how hotel reservation and group email workflows operate in practiceThe Communicator- Fluent in German (C1 / business level – required)- Fluent in English (required)- Spanish is a plus, but not required- Able to communicate clearly with both operational teams (e.g. reservations, group sales) and senior hotel or HQ management, adapting the message to the audience while keeping clarity and structure- Comfortable proactively engaging with clients via email, phone, or online calls when needed to support adoption and ensure effective daily use of the system- Able to help align day-to-day usage with longer-term operational goals and ensure the system is delivering value across both operational and management levelsTech-Aware (but not technical)- Understanding of hotel systems such as: -
